knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

## Motivation

A common source of silent failures in raster reprojection is a CRS string that
PROJ accepts but interprets differently from what was intended.  The classic
example is a bare `+proj=` PROJ string: PROJ treats it as a coordinate
*operation* (a unit conversion or a transformation step) rather than as a full
CRS definition that includes a datum.

`crs_describe()` calls PROJ directly via the C API and returns every output
representation it can produce.  This makes it easy to check whether a string
is being read as a CRS or as an operation, and to convert between formats.

```{r library}
library(rwarp)
```

## EPSG codes: the safe baseline

```{r epsg}
d <- crs_describe("EPSG:4326")
cat("id:", d$id, "\n")
cat("WKT2 (first 120 chars):\n")
cat(substr(d$wkt2_2019, 1, 120), "...\n")
cat("PROJ4:", d$proj4, "\n")
```

## Bare PROJ string: treated as an *operation*

Without `+type=crs`, PROJ interprets `+proj=laea` as a conversion step, not a
CRS.  It has no WKT1 form and no datum information.

```{r bare}
d_bare <- crs_describe("+proj=laea")
cat("id:", d_bare$id, "\n")
cat("description:", d_bare$description, "\n")
cat("wkt2_2019:", substr(d_bare$wkt2_2019, 1, 60), "...\n")
```

## Adding +type=crs: now it is a CRS

```{r typed}
d_typed <- crs_describe("+proj=laea +datum=WGS84 +type=crs")
cat("id:", d_typed$id, "\n")
cat("description:", d_typed$description, "\n")
cat("WKT2 (first 200 chars):\n")
cat(substr(d_typed$wkt2_2019, 1, 200), "...\n")
```

## EPSG:3412 (Antarctic Polar Stereographic)

```{r polar}
d3412 <- crs_describe("EPSG:3412")
cat("id:", d3412$id, "\n")
cat("description:", d3412$description, "\n")
cat("PROJ4:", d3412$proj4, "\n")
```

## WKT as input

`crs_describe()` accepts WKT strings too.  You can round-trip from EPSG to WKT
and back:

```{r wkt}
wkt <- crs_describe("EPSG:32755")$wkt1_gdal
cat("WKT1 (first 100 chars):", substr(wkt, 1, 100), "...\n")

d_from_wkt <- crs_describe(wkt)
cat("Round-trip id:", d_from_wkt$id, "\n")
```

## Quick validity check helper

A simple function that flags whether a string is recognised as a CRS:

```{r check}
is_crs <- function(x) {
  d <- crs_describe(x)
  is.na(d$error) && !is.na(d$wkt1_gdal)
}

is_crs("EPSG:4326")
is_crs("+proj=laea")                         # FALSE - operation, not CRS
is_crs("+proj=laea +datum=WGS84 +type=crs")  # TRUE
```
